_send_window_note: A scheduled run sends if the local hour is within [send_hour_local, send_hour_local + send_window_hours). The window absorbs GitHub's cron delays so a late run (e.g. 7 AM instead of 6) still sends. The last_sent_date guard keeps it to one email per day.
_recipients_note: Add or remove entries in 'recipients' to change who gets the email. The RECIPIENTS GitHub Actions secret, if set, overrides this list at runtime.
_llm_note: When enable_llm_examples is true and the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY secret is set, each word gets a single-sentence contextual example generated by Claude Haiku, cached per-word in state.json so it's only generated once.
